latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Playwright Stealth Scraper for OpenClaw.
- Enables scraping of dynamic websites with anti-bot defenses using Playwright and stealth plugins.
- Supports JavaScript-heavy sites including SPAs and React apps.
- Allows custom viewport and User-Agent spoofing.
- Provides the "stealth_scrape" tool for scraping by URL.

raw_record.summary: Scrapes websites using Playwright with stealth mode to bypass bot detection, supporting dynamic JS content and customizable viewport and User-Agent.
